newsitem.title: USA: Newport News, Va., plans $56 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Newport News, Va., plans $56 mln bond issue.

text.p: Newport News, Va., will sell two general obligation bond issues totalling $56 million by competitive bid on December 11, a city budget official said Wednesday.
A $28 million water bond issue will finance development at the King William reservoir, and a new water treatment plant and well construction.
"Debt service is paid from proceeds of the water system but they become GO bonds because the city backs it," said budget office spokesman Bill Keeler.

The other part of the deal is a $28 million GO capital improvement bond issue, to finance a police and fire communications system, energy effiency improvements at city buildings, and other capital projects.
